name: Order Exporter by ApusNest
author: Mateusz

sections.description:
Unlock powerful insights from your sales data! The Order Exporter by ApusNest is a lightweight, easy-to-use tool designed for one specific purpose: to export your WooCommerce orders into a clean, transaction-level CSV file. This format is perfect for conducting a professional Market Basket Analysis, which reveals which products are frequently bought together.

This plugin is the first step towards understanding customer purchasing behavior. Once you have your data, visit us at ApusNest.com to have your data transformed into an actionable report revealing hidden product associations, which you can use to boost your sales through cross-selling, product bundling, and smarter store layout.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Export: Generate a detailed CSV of your order items with a single click.
  • Flexible Filters: Easily filter orders by date range, order status, and order total.
  • Customer History Filters: Isolate orders from first-time buyers, returning customers, or export only the very first order from each customer.
  • Customizable Columns: Select exactly which data columns you want to include in your export.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage for modern, fast stores.
  • Secure and Compliant: Follows WordPress coding standards and best practices.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the order-exporter-by-apusnest folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Order Exporter (ApusNest) to start exporting your orders.
sections.faq:
Does this work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes! The plugin is fully compatible with HPOS to ensure it works seamlessly with modern WooCommerce installations.

What is Market Basket Analysis?

Market Basket Analysis is a data mining technique used to discover associations between items. It works by looking for combinations of items that occur together frequently in transactions. For example, it might find that customers who buy coffee also tend to buy sugar. Our service at ApusNest.com uses the data from this plugin to create a professional report for your store.

What format is the export file?

The plugin exports your order data as a CSV (Comma-Separated Values) file, which can be easily opened in any spreadsheet software like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or used with data analysis tools.
